rita (docs): quick failing alert from staging: several anchors with emojis in headings are missing after the mkdocs->docusaurus move. example: header 'Config ⚙️' ends up with id '#config-' but links use '#config-gear' so nav 404s.
noah (eng): emoji handling changed in the slugifier. some emoji become empty replacements. can you paste the markdown header?\
rita (docs): `## Config ⚙️` appears in docs/operations/config.md and the sidebar links to `#config-gear` (we used a custom explicit id historically).
link-bot: Found 4 broken internal links pointing to fragments: docs/operations/config.md -> #config-gear
noah (eng): short fix: restore explicit ids for critical headers, e.g. `## Config ⚙️ {#config-gear}`. long-term: we'll update slugify to map emoji to descriptive words or preserve ASCII fallbacks.
rita (docs): i'll add explicit ids for the 4 pages that currently break. i'll also grep for emoji in headings: `rg "^#{1,3} .*\p{Emoji}" docs/ | wc -l` returned 9 hits.
noah (eng): nice. add a small test in CI that fails if a sidebar link points to a fragment that doesn't exist in the built HTML. that should catch regressions.
ci-bot: docs build queued for branch docs/restore-explicit-ids (job #412).
rita (docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501 — explicit ids + CI smoke test. assigning @noah for review.
noah (eng): reviewing, small nit: use consistent id style (kebab-case). will approve after that tweak.
rita (docs): done, merged, and re-run publish. live site anchor check succeeded. thanks! :tada:
